nodes.description: Private owner address set in constructor to msg.sender; gates privileged functions (delegate, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress).
Mapping(address=>uint256) _onSaleNum counting sales per address; incremented in transferFrom and read by condition().
Mapping(address=>bool) canSale; addresses whitelisted in ensure() bypass the sale-condition checks.
uint256 _minSale minimum tradable amount, set in init() and enforced in condition().
uint256 _maxSale maximum tradable amount, set in init() and enforced in condition().
uint256 _saleNum maximum number of sales per address, set in init() and enforced in condition().
address tradeAddress whitelisted in ensure(), writable only by owner via setTradeAddress().
Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf token ledger mutated by transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Public uint totalSupply fixed at construction time as _supply * 10**decimals.
transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable; simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) internal view; whitelist gate comparing against owner, UNI, pairFor-derived pool and tradeAddress/canSale, otherwise requires condition().
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) public payable; checks allowance, calls ensure(), moves balanceOf and increments _onSaleNum.
approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
condition(address _from, uint _value) internal view; enforces _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale trade limits.
delegate(address a, bytes b) public payable; owner-only arbitrary delegatecall, allowing full takeover of the token storage.
init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) public; owner-only setter of _minSale/_maxSale/_saleNum.
batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) public payable; owner-only loop distributing tokens, computes total = _value * _tos.length.
setTradeAddress(address addr) public; owner-only setter of tradeAddress whitelist.
pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure; deterministic CREATE2 pair address computation used by ensure().
msg.sender; used for allowance checks, owner comparisons and balance mutations without prior validation.
a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate(): executes attacker-controlled code in the token's storage context.
Unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend, evaluated without SafeMath and able to overflow.
_to parameter of transfer().
_value parameter of transfer().
_from parameter of transferFrom(), the account whose balance is debited.
_to parameter of transferFrom(), the credited account.
_value parameter of transferFrom(), the transferred amount.
a parameter of delegate(), the delegatecall target address.
b parameter of delegate(), the delegatecall payload.
_tos array parameter of batchSend(), attackers cannot supply it (owner-only) but length drives overflow math.
_value parameter of batchSend(), per-recipient amount.
saleNum parameter of init(), stored into _saleNum.
token parameter of init(), used to derive _minSale.
maxToken parameter of init(), used to derive _maxSale.
addr parameter of setTradeAddress(), stored into tradeAddress.
_to local inside batchSend loop, credited in balanceOf.
total local in batchSend holding _value * _tos.length.

edges.reason: transfer() forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
_to of transfer() is passed as the recipient of transferFrom().
_value of transfer() is passed as the amount of transferFrom().
msg.sender becomes the _from account of the delegated transferFrom().
transferFrom() calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before moving balances.
_from parameter flows into ensure() for whitelist evaluation.
_value drives allowance subtraction and balanceOf mutation in transferFrom().
delegate() authorizes execution solely by requiring msg.sender == owner.
delegate() reaches the arbitrary delegatecall with attacker-controlled target and payload.
parameter a is the external address supplied to delegatecall.
parameter b is the raw calldata executed via delegatecall in the token context.
batchSend() is gated only by msg.sender == owner.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath, reaching the unchecked multiply.
_value is an operand of the unchecked multiplication.
_tos.length is an operand of the unchecked multiplication.
total is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender] in batchSend().
loop local _to is credited in balanceOf[_to].
ensure() falls back to condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure() grants a free pass when _from or _to equals owner.
ensure() grants a free pass when canSale[_from] is true.
ensure() grants a free pass when _from equals tradeAddress.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to cap sales per address.
condition() compares _value against _minSale.
condition() compares _value against _maxSale.
condition() compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
transferFrom() decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from].
transferFrom() reads and writes balanceOf for sender and recipient.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner to set the whitelist address.
init() requires msg.sender == owner to set the trade limits.
addr parameter is written into the tradeAddress whitelist.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
approve() mutates the allowance mapping.
init() writes _minSale from the token parameter.
init() writes _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init() writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only an argument of transfer() and must be folded into its enclosing function.
_value is only an argument of transfer() and must be folded into its enclosing function.
_from belongs to transferFrom() and is consumed by the allowance/ensure checks there.
_to belongs to transferFrom() and is consumed by the balanceOf credit there.
_value belongs to transferFrom() and drives allowance and balance mutation.
parameter a directly feeds the delegatecall target unsafe operation.
parameter b directly feeds the delegatecall payload unsafe operation.
_tos is the array consumed by the batchSend loop.
_value is the per-recipient amount consumed by batchSend.
saleNum is only stored into _saleNum by init().
token is only used to derive _minSale in init().
maxToken is only used to derive _maxSale in init().
addr is only stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress().
loop local _to is an internal artifact of the batchSend loop.
local total is the result of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend and belongs to that unsafe operation.
